summary: Clean Energy Technologies filed an 8-K on November 4, 2026 disclosing a securities purchase agreement with FuFront AI Pte. Ltd. of Singapore for a $2,000,000 convertible promissory note, funded at closing the same day. The note matures October 3, 2027, bears 12% annual interest, is convertible six months after issuance at 85% of the lowest traded price over the prior ten trading days, subject to a 4.99% beneficial-ownership blocker and a Nasdaq Rule 5635(d) cap of 2,432,004 shares absent shareholder approval. This is a routine private convertible financing, not a special situation; watch dilution and any shareholder-approval solicitation.
